name: United Plantations Berhad
overview: 2026年United Plantations Berhad的业务动态主要集中在种植板块：季度产量披露显示，截至2026年9月30日止季度，Crude Palm Oil产量同比上升14.95%至93,606公吨，Palm Kernel产量同比上升23.21%至20,211公吨，Coconuts产量同比上升8.53%至26,632,097颗；全年累计产量亦均高于上年同期。公司年内未公告新增、缩减或出售任何业务线，亦未披露新合约。
overview_en: In 2026, United Plantations Berhad's business developments were mainly in the plantation segment: quarterly production disclosures show that for the quarter ended 30 September 2026, Crude Palm Oil output rose 14.95% year-on-year to 93,606 MT, Palm Kernel output rose 23.21% year-on-year to 20,211 MT, and Coconuts output rose 8.53% year-on-year to 26,632,097 nuts; year-to-date cumulative output was also higher than the prior-year period.

segments.name: 种植
segments.note: 年内按季及按月披露Crude Palm Oil、Palm Kernel和Coconuts产量，截至2026年9月30日止季度及全年累计产量均高于上年同期。
segments.note_en: During the year, quarterly and monthly production of Crude Palm Oil, Palm Kernel and Coconuts was disclosed;

actions.title: DISCLOSURE ON QUARTERLY PRODUCTION
actions.text: 截至2026年9月30日止季度，Crude Palm Oil产量93,606公吨，同比增14.95%；Palm Kernel产量20,211公吨，同比增23.21%；Coconuts产量26,632,097颗，同比增8.53%。
actions.text_en: For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, Crude Palm Oil output was 93,606 MT, up 14.95% year-on-year; Palm Kernel output was 20,211 MT, up 23.21% year-on-year; Coconuts output was 26,632,097 nuts, up 8.53% year-on-year.

actions.title: DISCLOSURE ON QUARTERLY PRODUCTION
actions.text: 截至2026年6月30日止季度，Crude Palm Oil产量75,677公吨，同比减2.82%；Palm Kernel产量15,784公吨，同比减1.43%；Coconuts产量23,716,151颗，同比增0.59%。
actions.text_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, Crude Palm Oil output was 75,677 MT, down 2.82% year-on-year; Palm Kernel output was 15,784 MT, down 1.43% year-on-year; Coconuts output was 23,716,151 nuts, up 0.59% year-on-year.

actions.title: DISCLOSURE ON QUARTERLY PRODUCTION
actions.text: 截至2026年3月31日止季度，Crude Palm Oil产量66,746公吨，同比增4.46%；Palm Kernel产量14,330公吨，同比增10.91%；Coconuts产量23,593,465颗，同比增19.04%。
actions.text_en: For the quarter ended 31 March 2026, Crude Palm Oil output was 66,746 MT, up 4.46% year-on-year; Palm Kernel output was 14,330 MT, up 10.91% year-on-year; Coconuts output was 23,593,465 nuts, up 19.04% year-on-year.
